title: An arrest is happening now
officerCan: Use no more force than is necessary to effect the arrest.
officerCannot: Fail to inform a relative or nominated person of the arrest and place of detention.
Hold you beyond 24 hours, excluding travel time, without producing you before a Magistrate.

quotableLine.en: I am not resisting. Please tell me the grounds of arrest, and please inform my family member on this number.
quotableLine.hi: मैं विरोध नहीं कर रहा। कृपया गिरफ़्तारी का आधार बताइए, और इस नंबर पर मेरे परिवार को सूचित कीजिए।
quotableLine.ta: நான் எதிர்க்கவில்லை. கைது செய்வதற்கான காரணங்களைச் சொல்லுங்கள், இந்த எண்ணில் என் குடும்பத்தினருக்குத் தெரிவியுங்கள்.
quotableLine.te: నేను ఎదిరించడం లేదు. అరెస్టుకు గల కారణాలు చెప్పండి, ఈ నంబర్‌లో నా కుటుంబ సభ్యులకు తెలియజేయండి.
quotableLine.bn: আমি বাধা দিচ্ছি না। গ্রেপ্তারের কারণ জানান, আর এই নম্বরে আমার পরিবারের সদস্যকে জানান।
quotableLine.mr: मी विरोध करत नाही. अटकेची कारणे सांगा, आणि या क्रमांकावर माझ्या कुटुंबातील सदस्याला कळवा.
quotableLine.kn: ನಾನು ವಿರೋಧಿಸುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ. ಬಂಧನದ ಕಾರಣಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸಿ, ಮತ್ತು ಈ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗೆ ನನ್ನ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಸದಸ್ಯರಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿಸಿ.

doNotSay: Anything resembling resistance, pulling away, or raising your hands.
Any confession or explanation of the alleged offence.
documentNow: The time of arrest, the grounds stated, and the name of the person the police said they would inform.

options.label: Comply physically, and state the two requests: grounds, and inform family.
options.rationale: Resisting converts a bad arrest into a fresh offence.

options.label: Give a specific name and number for the s.48 intimation.
options.rationale: Vague requests get lost; a name and number is actionable.

options.label: Note the arrest time — production before a Magistrate is due within 24 hours excluding travel.
options.rationale: The clock is the single most useful fact for a lawyer.

verification.notes: Placeholder from PRD table. Not checked against bare act. Needs advocate sign-off for legal accuracy AND for escalation risk (PRD R3).
